title: Speaking Practice 12 - Describe a Person Who Inspired You
description: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Describe a person who has inspired you.

stimuli.title: Part 2: Describe a Person Who Inspired You
stimuli.content:
You will have 1 minute to prepare and then speak for 1-2 minutes.

Describe a person who has inspired you.

You should say: who this person is, how you know them, what they did that inspired you, and explain why they had such an impact on you.

questionGroups.instruction: Speak for 1-2 minutes using the prompts.

questions.content: Describe a person who has inspired you.

explanation.sampleAnswer: I would like to talk about my high school math teacher, Mr. Tran. He was an exceptional educator who went beyond just teaching formulas. He showed genuine care for each student and made complex concepts accessible through real-life examples. What inspired me most was his dedication despite his modest salary. He would stay after school to help struggling students for free. His passion for teaching made me believe that one career can truly make a difference in people's lives.
explanation.tips: Structure: who, how you know them, what inspired you, why

questions.content: Do you think it is important to have role models?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, I believe role models provide guidance and motivation, especially for young people who are still figuring out their path in life.

questions.content: How can parents be good role models for their children?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Parents can lead by example — showing honesty, hard work, and kindness in their daily actions rather than just telling children what to do.
